## Activity

During June 2019, Market Eye Clinic completed 389 captures. Activity was recorded for the month as part of routine site operations. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. Overall, the reported activity provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes for the period.

## Image quality

There were 17 ungradable captures. The ungradable rate was 4.4 per cent. This measure is reported alongside the total number of captures to support monitoring of image quality and identify the proportion of images that could not proceed through grading. The result should be considered with the recorded activity for June 2019.

## Grading

A total of 65 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 2. This records the central turnaround measure for grading during the reporting period. The activity, image quality and grading figures provide a concise summary of operations at Market Eye Clinic in June 2019.
